summary: Comprehensive backend pytest (27 tests, 26 pass + 1 xfail) covering auth/register/login/me/logout/forgot+reset, super-admin seed login, release draft validation (today+7 rule), submit guards (cover/contract), payment (Rp35k pay-per-release + Rp500k subscription) with mock-pay activation, admin dashboard/labels/release actions, CMS landing GET+PATCH persistence, admin-user creation with role guard, artist sub-account creation+login+role restrictions, and activity logs. Fixed 2 critical backend bugs while testing (MongoDB _id serialization in /auth/register response and in /admin/activity-logs). Frontend smoke-tested landing page (simulator + FAQ work) and admin login from UI (could not confirm redirect within 3s wait).

critical.issue: Returned 500 because label_doc still contained MongoDB ObjectId _id after insert_one before being returned in JSON. FIXED by popping _id after insert.

Returned 500 because log_activity stored `before`/`after` dicts that included the source document's _id ObjectId (e.g. in admin_update_label `before=label` had _id). Subsequent list endpoint hit ObjectId serialization. FIXED by stripping _id in log_activity helper.

Brute-force lockout is ineffective behind the K8s ingress. `identifier = f"{request.client.host}:{email}"` resolves to different internal pod IPs (10.208.138.130, .133, etc.) per request because uvicorn does not honour X-Forwarded-For by default. Verified by running 7 wrong logins for one email and observing the DB has two distinct identifier rows. Lockout never engages in production-like env.

minor.issue: Returns `reset_token` in response body (by design for MVP per dev notes). Remove before going to production.
Returns `verification_token` in response (by design for MVP). Remove before production.

integration_issues.issue: After filling superadmin@rilismusik.com / SuperAdmin#2026 and clicking Masuk, URL stayed at /login after 3s wait. Backend login API works fine (confirmed via pytest). Could be: (a) AuthContext does not redirect to /admin/dashboard for super_admin role, (b) submit handler bound to wrong button, or (c) need longer wait. Main agent should verify the login button onClick and the role-based redirect logic in AuthContext/Login.jsx.

Fix brute-force lockout to derive client IP from `X-Forwarded-For` / `X-Real-IP` header (or trust proxy via ProxyHeadersMiddleware with trusted_hosts='*') so identifier is stable across pods.

Optional: in /api/releases/draft and similar paths, fix /api/releases/ list endpoint with trailing slash and CORS preflight handling for consistency.

CORS allows credentials with `allow_origins=[frontend_url, 'http://localhost:3000']` — good. Verify FRONTEND_URL env always matches deployed origin.
Email verification + password reset tokens are returned in API responses (MVP-only). Mark TODO before prod.
/api/releases/ uses trailing slash — frontend axios calls should match to avoid 307 redirect issues.

rca_of_the_issue: Two related serialization bugs: Motor's insert_one mutates the dict in place with an ObjectId at `_id`, so any code path that returned a recently-inserted document (auth/register response, log_activity's `before` field from a non-projected find_one) leaked ObjectId into FastAPI's JSON encoder which then raises 500. Mitigation: always project `{'_id': 0}` when reading or pop after insert; activity-log helper now strips _id from both before/after.
